species: We developed a purification of Saccharomyces cerevisiae stress granule cores formed in response to sodium azide treatment (Figure 1)
disease_state: We developed a purification of Saccharomyces cerevisiae stress granule cores formed in response to sodium azide treatment (Figure 1)
sample_source: We have developed large-scale purifications of budding yeast and mammalian (HEK293T cell) stress granule cores that do not rely on immunoprecipitation of candidate protein constituents.
strain: To exclude peculiarities of a specific yeast genotype, we carried out purifications from three S. cerevisiae strains (YER165W with PAB1-GFP, JD1370, and YAG1021)
